evals.name: chrome-arrow-turbosnap
evals.prompt: For the TurboSnap docs page I need a new image of the build screen for a build where TurboSnap skipped most stories, wrapped in the browser window, with an arrow pointing at the TurboSnap indicator. Put it in the Turbosnap section and call it turbosnap-buildscreen-skipped.
evals.expected_output: A frame in the Turbosnap section, composed from current Chromatic library components, wrapped in BrowserChrome with a flush clip frame (x+1,y+32, w-2, bottom radii 7), one house orange arrow aimed at the TurboSnap indicator, 2x PNG export. The whole arrow (with tail) and the browser's bottom edge sit inside the frame.

evals.name: crop-pointer-verify
evals.prompt: Make a cropped image for the UI Tests section showing someone clicking the 'Verify changes' button on the build screen. Name it build-verify-changes-click.
evals.expected_output: A small (~560x286) #F6F9FC frame in UI Tests showing a browser corner: top bar and right edge each 25px in, the page scrolled inside the clip frame so Verify changes is visible, and a pointer whose fingertip is on the button.

evals.name: no-section-asks
evals.prompt: I'm writing up the component owners filter for the docs. Can you make an image of the build screen with an arrow pointing at the owner filter dropdown?
evals.expected_output: No frame built yet; asks which section to use, suggesting the existing 'Component Owners' section. If the owner filter doesn't exist in the library or file, also asks for a screenshot or design rather than inventing it.
